mechanism: Concurrent use of two corticosteroids results in additive systemic and local glucocorticoid effects, increasing risk of adverse effects including HPA axis suppression, hyperglycemia, and immunosuppression.
action: Avoid concurrent use of prednisolone ophthalmic and systemic betamethasone; if both are necessary, use lowest effective doses and monitor for corticosteroid toxicity and HPA axis suppression.
